question_summary: Contractor requests approval to substitute PEX piping for the specified copper domestic water piping (Section 22 11 16) prior to ordering material.
proposed_solution: Use PEX piping in lieu of copper domestic water piping.
deadline_text: A response by the end of the day would let us keep the order on track.
routing_rationale: The request concerns a domestic water piping material substitution under Division 22, which falls under the Plumbing/Fire Protection Engineer's review authority.
